items.html: Now we shall explain the matter of Adam ha Rishon, how he expanded in these Olamot. I have already notified you in the article Studied in the House of Eliyahu, section The World Exists Six Thousand Years, in Parashat Bereshit, regarding the sin of Adam ha Rishon, that Adam ha Rishon contained three Olamot, which are Beria Yetzira and Assiya.
